text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san's dancing naturally draws 
everyone's eyes to her, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really~? Really~~~~!! Ehehe~ I'm so 
happy~♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's true. There seems to be 
something... that I am lacking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that Air Messiah was in the middle 
of special dance training, I brought some 
refreshments, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mecchan-senpai, you're so stiff~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Stiff? I should be dancing on rhythm, 
however. ...One more time...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Nothing's changed at aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The textbook said to do it like this, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Textbooks are important too! They're 
important, but... what's even more 
important is taking on challenges! Taking 
the plunge!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I know! Teacher Vivlos will show you the 
ropesâª First of allâ

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's indulge♪ Let's live like celebs♪ 
Let's give it a try~~~!!
choice_data_list: Let's try acting a little spoiled
Let's try acting like a celeb

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Could you grab my water bottle 
for me? Pretty please~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Fufu~n♪ Thank you! Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So this is... "being pampered." I see. I 
will give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer. Would you mind handing 
me a towel?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. You really helped me 
out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...And with that... What do you think, 
Vivlos-san?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It's so stiiiiff!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mecchan-senpai♪ A celebrity! You're a 
total celebrity~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, I am familiar with 
it. In fact, quite knowledgeable, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Nothing's changed at aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos-san taught me that this is what it 
means to be a celebrity.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Being a celebrity means giving it your all 
every single day. Moving forward, even if 
it's just little by little...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's not quite what I think of when I hear 
'celebrity'... ...Ehehe, but I'm still so 
happy♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I take back saying you're rigid~~~~!! 
That's what makes you so great, 
Met-chan-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Taking it one step at a time, huh! Ehehe. 
That's celebrity style too, isn't it♪
